name: a flat house rooftop at night: a concrete roof slab with a low parapet in its back corner, a water tank on a steel stand, a TV antenna, a plastic stool and a small telescope on a tripod, the city roofs far behind under a deep night sky
fits: anything watched in the night sky from home: twinkling stars, planets, meteors, the moon rising, satellites passing; the hero hangs in the sky over the roof, the telescope or the viewer stands on the slab
recipe: one iso slab as the roof that bleeds past the frame with a seam grid, two low parapet blocks with a coping along the back edges, the tank as an iso cylinder on a block stand, the antenna as a thin cylinder with bars, a stool as iso blocks, a telescope as cylinders on a tripod, the far city as low iso blocks at parallax 0.35, a gradient night sky with faint stars at 0.3; no sea, land, hills, fields or space sphere
